parent_objective: test whether old-key recovery plus current-family conflict residual can move beyond the M386 micro base without making M267/M264 row15 safe

public_gates: M267/M264 first replay retains 17/17 success drops including row15
forbidden_shortcuts: do not promote checkpoint from exact losses alone
do not lower M267/M264 or old-key thresholds
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: The M389 conflict residual can preserve the M267/M264 wrong-history boundary while the M384 old-key recovery residual improves cumulative old-key normal-margin slack, allowing a larger proof-safe no-PPO repair movement than M386's alpha 0.00075 micro step.
success_criteria: produce one or more no-PPO repair/interpolation candidates from the M386 base
exact M297/M270 and old-key exact surrogate do not regress
M267/M264 first replay passes 17/17 success drops with row15 still colliding under wrong history
cumulative old-key replay passes after M267/M264 first replay
source-diverse protected gate and M183/M170 first replay pass before any full public gate is admitted
failure_criteria: conflict residual is too weak and M267/M264 row15 becomes safe
conflict residual is too strong and blocks old-key recovery movement
exact objectives pass but closed-loop replay fails

commands.name: no_ppo_conflict_repair_probe
commands.command: Run exact_post_ppo_repair with old-key recovery and current-family conflict corpus, then gate bounded candidates in M267/M264 and cumulative old-key replay; no PPO.

decision_rule: M390 can admit a full public gate only if a no-PPO bounded repair candidate passes exact objectives, M267/M264 first replay, cumulative old-key replay, source-diverse proof, and M183/M170 first replay without actor-contract changes.
next_blocker: pending M390 no-PPO conflict residual repair probe
